query: INSERT INTO runtime_tokens (conversation_id,sandbox_id,token_hash,peer_address) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4::text::inet) ON CONFLICT (conversation_id) DO UPDATE SET sandbox_id=EXCLUDED.sandbox_id,token_hash=EXCLUDED.token_hash,peer_address=EXCLUDED.peer_address,expires_at=NULL,created_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
